signals.name: boundaryIterations
signals.quantity: number of MultipartStream.readBoundary() calls during one execution (boundary iterations of the multipart parser loop)
signals.reset: V1Counters.reset() called at the start of V1Guidance.getInput() before each execution

signals.name: headerBytes
signals.quantity: number of MultipartStream.readByte() calls made while MultipartStream.readHeaders() runs, during one execution (header bytes scanned one at a time)
signals.storage: ThreadLocal<long[]> in V1Counters, slot [1] for counter and slot [2] for inHeaders flag (0 or 1)
signals.reset: V1Counters.reset() called at the start of V1Guidance.getInput() before each execution

signals.name: multipartWork
signals.quantity: multipart parser work s = alpha*(boundaryIterations/B_REF) + beta*(headerBytes/H_REF) with alpha = beta = 0.5, B_REF = 10 and H_REF = 512 (the fuzz test's PART_HEADER_SIZE_MAX), computed in handleResult from the two measured counters of the same execution
signals.storage: computed in-line in V1Guidance.handleResult() from the two measured counters; the resulting double is stored with the corpus entry for retention/prioritization
signals.reset: recomputed from fresh counter values each execution (counters are reset in getInput())
signals.read: computed and consumed directly in V1Guidance.handleResult() for retention decisions and in lastSignals() for external reporting

plans.retention: Keep the input if multipartWork exceeds the maximum multipartWork of the corpus. Choose parents for mutation with probability proportional to their multipartWork. Secondary (while multipartWork is flat): also retain inputs that are longer than the longest input in the corpus (growing toward input_bytes=527 and beyond up to the input size limit 10240), and with 10% probability retain any input longer than a randomly chosen corpus member, so that input length grows toward the target's input_bytes within the first minute even when readHeaders/readBoundary code paths are not yet reached.
mutation: byte-flip: flip a random bit in a random byte of the input
byte-insert: insert a random byte at a random position
byte-delete: remove a byte at a random position
byte-overwrite: replace a byte at a random position with a random value
havoc: apply 1-8 randomly chosen byte-level mutations in sequence

repetition [R45a]: select a random region (1 byte to half the input), repeat it k times where k is chosen so the result approaches the input size limit (10240 bytes); this doubles or more the header content or replicates part structures to grow toward input_bytes rapidly

dictionary-insert [R45b]: insert or overwrite at a random position one of the 8 dictionary tokens extracted from the MultipartStream source: CR (0x0D), LF (0x0A), CRLF (0x0D0A), CRLFCRLF (0x0D0A0D0A), DASHDASH (0x2D2D), CRLF-DASHDASH (0x0D0A2D2D), COLON (0x3A), SPACE (0x20)
splice: given two corpus parents, take a prefix of one and a suffix of the other at random cut points
